definitions.explanation: A large area covered with trees and vegetation. Denser and larger than {林|はやし} (grove/small woods).

examples.japanese: {森|もり}の{中|なか}を{歩|ある}きました。
{森|もり}にはたくさんの{動物|どうぶつ}がいます。
examples.english: There are many animals in the forest.

examples.japanese: {深|ふか}い{森|もり}に{入|はい}らないでください。
examples.english: Please don't enter the deep forest.

notes:
Different from {林|はやし} which refers to a smaller grove or woods. {森|もり} implies a larger, denser forested area. Also a common family name in Japan.

Related: {森林|しんりん} (forest, more formal).
